title: Swirling Zombie Vortex
description: A vibrant surreal painting features a green rotting zombie head with glowing orange eyes and an open screaming mouth, positioned at the center of a large swirling vortex of green, blue, and pink. Pink peonies and colorful translucent circles float around the composition alongside fiery orange flames at the bottom and geometric pyramid shapes in the upper right.
